# Leave and Time Off Policy

## Paid Time Off

Everyone at Example Co gets 20 days of paid vacation and personal days each year, plus the public holidays of their country. Please record each day off in the team calendar.

### Sick Days

Sick days are paid in full and never count against your vacation.

We do not keep a sick-day balance. Tell your lead as soon as you know you will be out, and say roughly for how long.

If you are away for more than five working days in a row, we move you onto medical leave and ask for a doctor's note.

## Your First Quarter

Welcome aboard. During your first month you will pair with a buddy who answers questions about tools and process.

Your lead will meet you every week to agree on goals for the quarter.

## Sabbatical

Every three years you may take a 6-week paid sabbatical. Give your team three months of notice so they can plan around it.
